title: Junior Software Engineer
resume_suggestions: Highlight experience with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, SQL databases, and Git. Mention any projects that involved writing clean code or participating in code reviews. Include any experience with Docker, cloud deployment, or CI/CD if applicable.
summary: BrightPath Technologies is hiring a Junior Software Engineer to develop and maintain backend services. The role requires proficiency in Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, SQL databases, and Git, with an emphasis on writing clean code and participating in code reviews. Preferred skills include Docker, cloud deployment, and CI/CD.

title: Entry-Level QA Automation Engineer
responsibilities: working closely with developers and product teams
summary: Northstar Health Systems is hiring an Entry-Level QA Automation Engineer to test web applications and support release quality. The candidate should have experience with manual testing, test case design, bug reporting, regression testing, and basic automation. Preferred skills include Playwright, Selenium, Python, JavaScript, Git, and Jira.

title: Technical Support Engineer
resume_suggestions: Highlight experience in troubleshooting software and system issues, strong communication skills, and familiarity with basic networking, Windows, macOS, SQL, ticket management, log analysis, and customer service. Include any experience or knowledge of REST APIs, SaaS platforms, Linux commands, and support tools.
summary: CloudDesk Solutions is hiring a Technical Support Engineer in Pleasanton, CA to assist customers with troubleshooting software and system issues. The role requires strong communication skills, basic networking knowledge, Windows and macOS troubleshooting, ticket management, SQL basics, log analysis, and customer service experience. Familiarity with REST APIs, SaaS platforms, Linux commands, and support tools is preferred.
